pageTitle: Speech Script Preview with Local Browser Voices · Oralo
pageDescription: Paste a speech script, choose a browser-reported local voice, and preview wording at a relative speed. No sign-up or audio download. Voices depend on your device and browser.
heading: Hear your script before you speak.
intro: Paste your script and preview sentences, numbers, and abbreviations with a browser-reported local voice. Synthetic speech is a reference, not a substitute for your own timed rehearsal.
privacy: No sign-up or microphone. This site does not upload or save your script. A browser-reported local voice is not an independently verified offline guarantee. Do not paste confidential material.
scriptPlaceholder: Paste up to 5,000 Unicode characters. Numbers and punctuation can stay. Listen to check how the voice reads them.
lifecycle: Your script stays only in this page. It is not restored after a refresh, leaving, or changing the page language. Keep your own copy.
languageHelp: One voice reads the whole script. Mixed-language text does not switch voices automatically. Check how your voice reads numbers, abbreviations, and names.
mixedHelp: Other-language text was found. The selected main-language voice will still read it. Change the main language or preview each language separately.
voiceHelp: Names and language tags come from your browser and vary by device. Check the selected region, accent, and mixed-language reading by listening.
rateHelp: 1.0 is the selected voice's baseline, not words per minute. The same value can sound different across voices.
stopHelp: This version has no pause or resume. Play starts from the beginning after stopping. Moving to the background stops playback without automatic resumption.
outputHelp: If you hear nothing after pressing Play, check volume, mute settings, and the audio output device. The page status does not confirm audible output.
unready: No voice list is available yet. Reload the list, or check and install speech voices in system settings, then try again.
unsupported: This browser does not provide the speech synthesis interface required here. Try another browser. Local voices are not guaranteed there either.
noMatch: The browser reports no local voice for the selected language. This tool will not switch to a remote voice. Check system speech settings, or try another browser and reload voices. Installing voices may require an internet connection.
idle: Choose a local voice, then press Play preview.
stopped: Stopped. Play will start from the beginning.
edited: Content or settings changed, so playback stopped. Play will start from the beginning.
hidden: Playback stopped when the page left the foreground. Press Play to start again from the beginning.
finished: Preview finished. Synthetic playback is not your actual speaking duration.
tooLong: The script exceeds 5,000 Unicode characters. Shorten it before playing. It will not be truncated.
voiceRequired: Choose a local voice that matches the main reading language.
voiceInvalid: The selected local voice is unavailable or cannot be confirmed. Playback stopped. Reload and choose a voice again.
invalidRate: Choose a relative rate from the list.
markup: This version accepts plain text only. Remove angle brackets and HTML or SSML tags before previewing.
cluster: The script contains a character cluster that cannot be split safely. Simplify that passage and try again.
notVisible: Bring this page to the foreground, then press Play.
notAllowed: The browser did not allow speech to start. Press Play directly and check its playback settings.
audioError: Audio output is unavailable. Check the volume, output device, or other apps using audio.
networkError: The selected voice service returned a network error, so playback stopped. No remote voice was selected as a fallback. Choose a voice again. This tool cannot guarantee that service operates fully offline.
startTimeout: Speech did not start in time and was canceled. Check the voice and output device, then try again manually.
endTimeout: Speech did not finish within the waiting limit and was canceled. Shorten the script or choose a voice again.
engineTooLong: The selected voice could not process this passage. Shorten the script and try again.
invalidArgument: The voice service did not accept these settings. Choose a valid rate and try again.
interrupted: Speech was interrupted. You can retry manually from the beginning.
genericError: Speech failed and playback stopped. Choose a local voice again, or try another browser.
noJs: JavaScript is required for the preview. The explanation and tool links below are still available.
languageConfirm: Changing the page language will stop playback and clear your script. Continue?
otherToolBody: Use the speech length estimator with Chinese character or English word counts and your own pace. Scripts do not transfer between tools. Keep your own copy and paste it manually.

faqs: Does a local voice guarantee fully offline use?

No independent audit is implied. This tool only lists voices the browser reports as local and does not fall back to remote voices. This page does not control browser or system service internals. Installing a voice may require an internet connection.
Is my script saved or uploaded?

This site does not save your script or send it to site APIs, analytics, or third-party scripts. Text is passed to the selected browser speech synthesis service. This is not an audit of all processing performed by your system.
What if no local voice is available?

The browser may not have loaded or reported a matching voice. Reload the list, or check speech voices in system settings and try again. Without a match, playback stays unavailable. There is no automatic remote fallback.
Will it read mixed languages and numbers accurately?

One voice reads the entire script without automatic language switching. The voice interprets numbers, abbreviations, names, and mixed text, and may misread or skip them. Check by listening. This is not a pronunciation standard.
Is playback time my speech duration?

No. A voice's relative rate is not characters or words per minute and does not represent your live delivery. Use the speech length estimator as a planning reference, then time your own full rehearsal.
Can I pause, download, or keep playing with the screen locked?

This version has Play and Stop only. Play starts over after stopping. Moving to the background stops playback without automatic resumption. There is no download, recording, or voice cloning. Short gaps can occur between segments.
No. The preview reads text with a synthetic voice and does not listen to you. See the product pages for Oralo's iPhone prompting experience and features.
methodBody: Paste a script, choose the main language, a browser-reported local voice, and a relative rate, then press Play. Stop to make changes and listen again.
statusTitle: A first listen. In your browser.
voicesReady: Choose one of the local voices reported for this language.
stopFailure: Playback could not be safely canceled. Close this page to stop it, and try another browser. Playback is disabled here.
limitBody: Short gaps may occur between passages. This preview uses one selected voice and does not measure your speaking time. You control every start; stopping, editing, or leaving the foreground never resumes playback automatically.
